_note: RegionDINO, scene + object mode: plain DINO on the whole image (2 global + 8 local crops, exactly DINO_SARDet) PLUS the DINO loss on object views cut around label-free regions. Shared keys (epochs, batch_size, scene view sizes, jitter, blur sigma) live in SARDet/shared/ssl_common.json and may not appear here. The dino / optim sections equal DINO_SARDet/config_ssl.json.

object_views._note: windows are sized from each region's own extent (no fixed pixel size); max_magnification stops tiny blobs being blown up; region_source random = the control with matched-size random windows
